description_zh: 访问 Facebook API 功能。

conditions.description_zh: 检测 Facebook API 是否已加载完成，并随时可以使用。
conditions.description_en: True when the Facebook API has loaded and is ready to be used.

conditions.description_zh: 检测用户是否已登录 Facebook 账号。
conditions.description_en: True if currently being viewed inside Facebook by a logged in user.
Triggered when the user successfully logs in.
Triggered when the user logs out.

conditions.description_zh: 登录后，用户名称可用时触发。
conditions.description_en: Triggered after login when the user's name becomes available.

actions.description_zh: 登录到应用程序，以便访问用户详细信息。
actions.description_en: Log the user in to the application so their details can be accessed.

params.desc_en: Requested permissions, separated by a comma. E.g. "public_profile".
params.desc_zh: 要请求的权限指令，使用逗号分割多个。如 "public_profile"

actions.description_zh: 弹出分享对话框，用户可以输入文字，也可以选择取消。
actions.description_en: Bring up a dialog where the user can share some text on their wall or choose to cancel.

actions.description_zh: 弹出分享对话框，用户可以共享应用程序的链接，也可以选择取消。
actions.description_en: Bring up a dialog where the user can share a link to the app on their wall or choose to cancel.

actions.description_zh: 弹出分享对话框，用户可以共享指定的链接，也可以选择取消。
actions.description_en: Bring up a dialog where the user can share a link on their wall or choose to cancel.

actions.description_zh: 将消息发布到用户的墙上。 用户应明确启动此操作。
actions.description_en: Publish a message to the user's wall.  The user should explicitly initiate this.

params.desc_en: The text to publish to the user's feed.  It is recommended to only do this when the user initiates the action.
params.desc_zh: 要发布到用户动态中的文本。建议仅在用户发起该操作时才执行此操作。

actions.description_zh: 发布指向用户墙的链接。 用户应明确启动此操作。
actions.description_en: Publish a link to the user's wall.  The user should explicitly initiate this.

params.desc_en: The text to publish to the user's feed.  It is recommended to only do this when the user initiates the action.
params.desc_zh: 要发布到用户动态消息中的文本内容。建议仅在用户发起操作时才进行此操作。

params.desc_en: The caption appearing beneath the link text.
params.desc_zh: 标题出现在链接文本下方。

params.desc_en: The description appearing beneath the caption.
The URL of an image on your server to use on the Share dialog.  Must include the http://
params.desc_zh: 要在 '分享' 对话框中使用的图像的URL。必须包含 http://

actions.description_zh: 在 Facebook 可试玩广告中，当用户点击行动号召按钮 (CTA) 时，触发此动作。
actions.description_en: In a Facebook Playable Ad, use this action when the user interacts with the call-to-action (CTA) in the ad.

expressions.description_zh: 获取用户的全名，如果用户已登录。
expressions.description_en: Get the user's full name, if they are logged in.

expressions.description_zh: 获取用户的名字，如果用户已登录。
expressions.description_en: Get the user's first name, if they are logged in.

expressions.description_zh: 获取用户的姓氏，如果用户已登录。
expressions.description_en: Get the user's last name, if they are logged in.

expressions.description_zh: 获取用户ID作为字符串，即使对于具有相同名称的用户也是如此。
expressions.description_en: Get the user's ID as a string, which is different even for users with the same name.

properties.description_en: The App ID Facebook gives you after creating an app.
properties.description_zh: Facebook创建应用程序后为您提供App ID。

properties.description_en: The App Secret Facebook gives you after creating an app. Only necessary for submitting scores!
properties.description_zh: App Secret在创建应用程序后Facebook为您提供。 仅必要提交分数！
